summary: Lead lists are curated from CQC data with explicit opportunity categories: new registrations (73), inadequate (53), requires improvement (2,904), not yet inspected (20,989). The live site presents these as structured data products. The lead list page (frontend/app/lead-list/page.tsx) and search page filter by opportunity type. The directory lead tests (frontend/lib/directory-leads.test.ts) verify lead data integrity. The service taxonomy test (frontend/lib/service-taxonomy.test.ts) validates categorization. Lead data comes from audited CQC sources, not AI fabrication.
assertions: Lead lists filtered by opportunity: new_90, inadequate, requires_improvement, not_yet_inspected
Data sourced from audited CQC pipeline, not AI generation
Lead list page test (frontend/lib/lead-list-page.test.ts) verifies rendering
Directory leads test verifies data integrity
Live site shows real-time counts: 73 new, 53 inadequate, 2,904 RI, 20,989 NYI
